properties.description: Fires when a single identity performs 2+ distinct attack techniques (privilege escalation, network exposure, data exposure, defense evasion) within one hour, indicating a coordinated attack rather than isolated activity.
properties.query:
let lookback = 1h;
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where ActivityStatusValue in ('Success', 'Start')
| extend AttackType = case(OperationNameValue has 'ROLEASSIGNMENTS/WRITE', 'PrivEsc-T1098', OperationNameValue has 'SECURITYRULES/WRITE', 'NetExposure-T1562', OperationNameValue has 'STORAGEACCOUNTS/WRITE' and tostring(parse_json(tostring(parse_json(Properties).requestbody)).properties.allowBlobPublicAccess) == 'true', 'DataExposure-T1530', OperationNameValue has 'DIAGNOSTICSETTINGS/DELETE', 'DefenseEvasion-T1562', '')
| where AttackType != ''
| summarize DistinctAttackTypes = dcount(AttackType), Techniques = make_set(AttackType), StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated) by Caller, CallerIpAddress
| where DistinctAttackTypes >= 2
